title: 无名的灯笼
summary: At a community lantern festival, two students discover a lantern with an unfinished poem and help its elderly maker complete it, revealing a story of love and memory.
topic: A lantern with an unfinished inscription

blocks.hanzi: 一年一度的元宵灯笼展又到了。这次展览在社区广场上举行，广场上挂满了五颜六色的灯笼。小雨和大明作为志愿者，帮忙布置灯笼。他们看到很多精美的灯笼，上面都写着主人的名字和心愿。
blocks.translation: The annual Lantern Festival lantern exhibition has arrived again. This exhibition is held in the community square, which is full of colorful lanterns. Xiao Yu and Da Ming, as volunteers, help arrange the lanterns. They see many exquisite lanterns, on which are written the owners' names and wishes.
blocks.pinyin: yīniányīdù de yuánxiāo dēnglóng zhǎn yòu dàole. zhècì zhǎnlǎn zài shèqū guǎngchǎng shàng jǔxíng, guǎngchǎng shàng guàmǎn le wǔyánliùsè de dēnglóng. Xiǎo Yǔ hé Dà Míng zuòwéi zhìyuànzhě, bāngmáng bùzhì dēnglóng. tāmen kàndào hěnduō jīngměi de dēnglóng, shàngmiàn dōu xiězhe zhǔrén de míngzì hé xīnyuàn.

blocks.hanzi: 突然，一个红色的灯笼吸引了他们的注意。这个灯笼很漂亮，上面画着几朵梅花，但奇怪的是，它没有写名字，只有一句没有写完的诗：“月光照在...”
blocks.translation: Suddenly, a red lantern caught their attention. This lantern was very beautiful, with several plum blossoms painted on it, but strangely, it had no name written, only an unfinished poem: 'Moonlight shining on...'
blocks.pinyin: tūrán, yīgè hóngsè de dēnglóng xīyǐn le tāmen de zhùyì. zhège dēnglóng hěn piàoliang, shàngmiàn huàzhe jǐduǒ méihuā, dàn qíguài de shì, tā méiyǒu xiě míngzì, zhǐyǒu yījù méiyǒu xiěwán de shī: “yuèguāng zhào zài...”

blocks.hanzi: 小雨指着灯笼说：“大明，你看，这个灯笼好特别，没写名字，诗也没写完。”
blocks.translation: Xiao Yu pointed at the lantern and said, 'Daming, look, this lantern is very special, it has no name written, and the poem is not finished either.'
blocks.pinyin: xiǎo yǔ zhǐ zhe dēng lóng shuō: “dà míng, nǐ kàn, zhè ge dēng lóng hǎo tè bié, méi xiě míng zì, shī yě méi xiě wán.”

blocks.hanzi: 大明仔细看了看，说：“是啊，好像有什么故事。我们应该找到它的主人。”
blocks.translation: Daming looked carefully and said, "Yes, it seems there is some story. We should find its owner."
blocks.pinyin: Dàmíng zǐxì kànlekàn, shuō: “shì a, hǎoxiàng yǒu shénme gùshì. Wǒmen yīnggāi zhǎodào tā de zhǔrén.”

blocks.hanzi: 他们问了很多邻居，但大家都不知道是谁做的。最后，一位老奶奶告诉他们，这个灯笼可能是张爷爷家的。
blocks.translation: They asked many neighbors, but everyone didn't know who did it. Finally, an old lady told them that this lantern might be from Grandpa Zhang's.
blocks.pinyin: tā men wèn le hěn duō lín jū, dàn dà jiā dōu bù zhī dào shì shuí zuò de. zuì hòu, yī wèi lǎo nǎi nai gào sù tā men, zhè ge dēng lóng kě néng shì zhāng yé ye jiā de.

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷住在社区的一角，平时很少出门。小雨和大明敲开了他家的门。开门的是一个慈祥的老爷爷。
blocks.translation: Grandpa Zhang lived in a quiet corner of the community and rarely went out. Xiao Yu and Da Ming knocked on his door, and a kind old man answered it.
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye zhù zài shèqū de yī jiǎo, píngshí hěnshǎo chūmén. Xiǎo Yǔ hé Dà Míng qiāokāi le tā jiā de mén. Kāi mén de shì yīgè cíxiáng de lǎoyéye.

blocks.hanzi: 大明问：“张爷爷，广场上的那个红色灯笼是您做的吗？为什么没有名字呀？”
blocks.translation: Daming asked: 'Grandpa Zhang, is that red lantern in the square made by you? Why doesn't it have a name?'
blocks.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zhāng yéye, guǎngchǎng shàng de nà gè hóngsè dēnglóng shì nín zuò de ma? Wèishénme méiyǒu míngzì ya？”

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷请他们进屋，慢慢地说：“那个灯笼是我做的，但它还没有完成。”
blocks.translation: Grandpa Zhang invited them into the house and said slowly, “That lantern was made by me, but it hasn't been completed yet.”
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye qǐng tāmen jìn wū, màn màn de shuō: “Nà gè dēng lóng shì wǒ zuò de, dàn tā hái méi yǒu wán chéng.”

blocks.hanzi: 小雨好奇地问：“为什么没完成呢？”
blocks.translation: Xiao Yu asked curiously: 'Why isn't it done?'
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Yǔ hàoqí de wèn: “Wèishénme méi wánchéng ne?”

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷叹了一口气，说：“那首诗是我想写给已故的老伴的。我们在一起五十年，她特别喜欢灯笼。去年她走了，我想做个灯笼纪念她。可是，我只记得‘月光照在’这四个字，后面的诗句怎么也想不起来了。”
blocks.translation: Grandpa Zhang sighed and said, 'That poem was meant for my deceased wife. We were together for fifty years, and she especially loved lanterns. Last year she passed away, and I wanted to make a lantern to commemorate her. But I only remember the four words "moonlight shines on," and I can't recall the rest of the verse.'
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye tàn le yī kǒu qì, shuō: “Nà shǒu shī shì wǒ xiǎng xiě gěi yǐ gù de lǎo bàn de. Wǒmen zài yīqǐ wǔ shí nián, tā tèbié xǐhuān dēnglong. Qùnián tā zǒu le, wǒ xiǎng zuò gè dēnglong jìniàn tā. Kěshì, wǒ zhǐ jìde ‘yuè guāng zhào zài’ zhè sì gè zì, hòumiàn de shījù zěnme yě xiǎng bù qǐlái le.”

blocks.hanzi: 小雨和大明对视了一眼。小雨说：“爷爷，您别急，我们帮您一起想。”
blocks.translation: Xiao Yu and Da Ming exchanged a glance. Xiao Yu said, 'Grandpa, don't worry, we'll help you think together.'
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Yǔ hé Dà Míng duì shì le yì yǎn. Xiǎo Yǔ shuō: “Yé ye, nín bié jí, wǒ men bāng nín yì qǐ xiǎng.”

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷笑了笑：“你们这些小娃娃会写诗吗？”
blocks.translation: Grandpa Zhang smiled and said: 'Can you little kids write poetry?'
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye xiào le xiào: “Nǐmen zhèxiē xiǎo wáwa huì xiě shī ma?”

blocks.hanzi: 大明说：“我们试试看。月光照在……哪里呢？”
blocks.translation: Da Ming said: “Let’s try. Where does the moonlight shine on...?”
blocks.pinyin: Dà Míng shuō: “Wǒmen shì shì kàn. Yuèguāng zhào zài…… nǎ lǐ ne?”

blocks.hanzi: 小雨沉思了一会儿，说：“月光照在地上，像她的笑容一样温暖。”
blocks.translation: Xiao Yu pondered for a while and said, “The moonlight shines on the ground, as warm as her smile.”
blocks.pinyin: xiǎoyǔ chénsī le yīhuìr, shuō: “yuèguāng zhào zài dìshàng, xiàng tā de xiàoróng yīyàng wēnnuǎn.”

blocks.hanzi: 这个句子让张爷爷非常激动，因为他知道这正是他要找的诗句。
blocks.translation: This sentence made Grandpa Zhang very excited, because he knew that this was exactly the verse he was looking for.
blocks.pinyin: zhè ge jù zi ràng zhāng yé ye fēi cháng jī dòng yīn wèi tā zhī dào zhè zhèng shì tā yào zhǎo de shī jù

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷听了，眼睛一下子亮了：“对！就是这样的！‘月光照在地上，像她的笑容一样。’ 我想起来了！后面应该是‘她在天上看着我，我在人间想着她。’”
blocks.translation: After Grandpa Zhang heard this, his eyes suddenly lit up: 'Right! That's it! "Moonlight shines on the ground, like her smile." I remember! The next part should be: "She is watching me from the sky, and I am thinking of her on earth."'
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye tīng le, yǎnjīng yīxiàzi liàng le: “Duì! Jiù shì zhèyàng de! ‘Yuèguāng zhào zài dìshang, xiàng tā de xiàoróng yīyàng.’ Wǒ xiǎng qǐlai le! Hòumiàn yīnggāi shì ‘Tā zài tiānshang kànzhe wǒ, wǒ zài rénjiān xiǎngzhe tā.’”

blocks.hanzi: 他激动地拿起笔，在灯笼上写下了完整的诗句。写完后，他又在灯笼的下方工工整整地写上了自己的名字——张明远。
blocks.translation: He excitedly picked up the pen and wrote the complete verse on the lantern. After writing, he neatly wrote his own name—Zhang Mingyuan—underneath the lantern.
blocks.pinyin: tā jīdòng de náqǐ bǐ, zài dēnglóng shàng xiěxià le wánzhěng de shījù. xiěwán hòu, tā yòu zài dēnglóng de xiàfāng gōnggōngzhěngzhěng de xiěshàng le zìjǐ de míngzì——Zhāng Míngyuǎn.

blocks.hanzi: 小雨和大明看到了完整的灯笼，都很高兴。小雨说：“爷爷，现在它完整了，而且非常美。”
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu and Daming saw the complete lantern, and both were very happy. Xiaoyu said: "Grandpa, now it is complete, and it's very beautiful."
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Yǔ hé Dà Míng kàn dào le wán zhěng de dēng lóng，dōu hěn gāo xìng。Xiǎo Yǔ shuō：“Yé ye，xiàn zài tā wán zhěng le，ér qiě fēi cháng měi。”

blocks.hanzi: 张爷爷说：“谢谢你们，让我完成了心愿。”
blocks.translation: Grandpa Zhang said: “Thank you for letting me fulfill my wish.”
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng yéye shuō: “Xièxiè nǐmen, ràng wǒ wánchéng le xīnyuàn.”

blocks.hanzi: 那天晚上，红色的灯笼被挂在了广场中央，大家看到了这首诗，都觉得很感动。张爷爷站在灯笼下，眼里闪着泪光。大家都被这个故事打动了，纷纷鼓掌。
blocks.translation: That evening, the red lantern was hung in the center of the square. Everyone saw this poem and felt very moved. Grandpa Zhang stood under the lantern with tears glistening in his eyes. Everyone was moved by this story and applauded.
blocks.pinyin: nà tiān wǎn shang, hóng sè de dēng lóng bèi guà zài le guǎng chǎng zhōng yāng, dà jiā kàn dào le zhè shǒu shī, dōu jué de hěn gǎn dòng. zhāng yé ye zhàn zài dēng lóng xià, yǎn lǐ shǎn zhe lèi guāng. dà jiā dōu bèi zhè ge gù shì dǎ dòng le, fēn fēn gǔ zhǎng.

blocks.hanzi: 从此以后，每年元宵节，张爷爷都会做同样的灯笼，上面写着那首诗和他的名字。他说，这样，他就永远不会忘记老伴。这个灯笼成了社区的象征，每年都会出现在灯笼展上。
blocks.translation: From then on, every year on the Lantern Festival, Grandpa Zhang would make the same lantern, with that poem and his name written on it. He said that in this way, he would never forget his wife. This lantern became a symbol of the community and appears every year at the lantern exhibition.
blocks.pinyin: cóng cǐ yǐ hòu, měi nián yuán xiāo jié, zhāng yé ye dōu huì zuò tóng yàng de dēng lóng, shàng miàn xiě zhe nà shǒu shī hé tā de míng zì. tā shuō, zhè yàng, tā jiù yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì lǎo bàn. zhè ge dēng lóng chéng le shè qū de xiàng zhēng, měi nián dōu huì chū xiàn zài dēng lóng zhǎn shàng.
